topic: OpenRouter :free models (20 RPM, 50 RPD at $0 vs 1,000 RPD after $10 balance)
caption:
Save this OpenRouter setup if you're testing free LLM API models.

Most devs miss the OpenRouter free models suffix (:free). You get 20 requests per minute and 50 requests daily at $0, no subscription needed.

Here's the upgrade trick: once your account hits $10 in lifetime credits, your daily cap jumps to 1,000 free requests, and those free calls don't drain your $10 balance.

beats.caption: Nobody tells you OpenRouter hides 50 free calls.
Any model ending in:free runs at 20 requests per minute.
You get 50 free calls daily with $0 spent up front.
Once you top up $10 lifetime, your daily cap hits 1,000.
Free model calls don't spend one cent of that $10 credit.
If you hit 429, swap to another:free model inside OpenRouter.
Save this before paying for 50 API keys.
